messages.subject: Postdoctoral Research Associate needed - Bozeman, MT
parts:
Dear group,

I am recruiting for a 1-year postdoctoral research associate to evaluate whether and how climate-driven changes in habitat conditions have affected breeding bird populations in the boreal-Arctic ecotone of western Alaska.  I would be indebted if members would circulate the attached announcement.

Thanks, 

Lance
